release_notes:
WireTrace v1.2.0

Maintenance release. Linux binaries (AppImage and .deb) are now published, with working in-app updates.

Fixed
- Data durability: atomic preferences save, concurrent log-write protection, fsync ordering
- ANSI/VT100 escape codes stripped from console, log, CSV, and plot
- CSV exports hardened against spreadsheet formula injection
- Linux: serial port released immediately on disconnect; AppImage bundles its dependencies
- The tab now resets when a device drops on its own
- Custom plot patterns can no longer freeze the app
- Window no longer opens off-screen after a monitor change

Fully backwards-compatible; no user action required to upgrade.
